name: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 - CDO
short_description: A half-marathon event in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines, taking place August 2, 2026, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 - CDO is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 2, 2026 in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the HOKA Midnight Run Asia brand, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, with the half-marathon serving as the primary distance. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) allow participants of different levels to join
Organized by Runrio, an established race organizer in the Philippines
Held in Cagayan de Oro, offering a race destination outside typical major-city venues
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

research_highlights: First gunstart for all distances (5K/10K/21K) is at 12:00 AM midnight, so runners need to arrive well before then for check-in and assembly.
Being held in August (rainy season in Cagayan de Oro), nighttime conditions are described as warm and humid, roughly 24–27°C, with possible passing showers.
The CDO course is described as running along wide city roads and river-adjacent sections, laid out for steady pacing rather than technical terrain.
CDO is a new addition to the HOKA Midnight Run Asia calendar for 2026, alongside Iloilo and Clark, as the series expands from its original Manila/Davao/Cebu legs.
Sibling legs of the same series have drawn large crowds — the 2026 Manila leg alone gathered close to 15,000 runners, following an earlier Davao opening leg.
research_watchouts: No refund or transfer of entry fee is given if the race is cancelled due to rain, storm, or other weather-related force majeure — a real risk given the rainy-season timing.
As a brand-new venue for the series, no participant reviews for the CDO leg specifically were found yet (aggregator pages like Worlds Marathons show 'No reviews yet' for this race).
Race bibs are non-transferable, so plans need to be firm once registered.

faqs.question: When is the HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 - CDO taking place?
faqs.answer: The HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 - CDO is scheduled to take place on August 2, 2026. The event will be held in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines. This date marks the primary race day for all distance categories offered as part of this event.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance options at this event: 21.1km (half-marathon), 10km, and 5km. The half-marathon distance of 21.1km is listed as the primary distance for the HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 - CDO, making it the featured race category.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: This race is organized by Runrio, operating under the brand name HOKA Midnight Run Asia. Runrio is responsible for coordinating the event, which is taking place in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines, as part of the broader HOKA Midnight Run Asia series.

faqs.question: Is registration open yet?
faqs.answer: Registration for the HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 - CDO has not yet been announced. Prospective participants will need to wait for further updates from the organizer, Runrio, regarding sign-up details, deadlines, and any related registration information for this event.
